description: A Flutter widget implementing a bottom sheet for selecting payment methods with deep link integrations to Paytm, Google Pay, and PhonePe, including fallback messaging.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a bottom sheet with different payment options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Creates a list tile for each payment method option.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch a payment app via a deep link URI and shows a message if the app is not installed.
